item.title: Meralin and Princess Kinara
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Lord-Kvento
  • 発売日: 2018-11-10
  • スコア: 5.0200000000000005/10 (14 人評価)
  • 日本語名: Meralin and Princess Kinara
  • 英語名: 无

あらすじ

The merchant have finally arrived in the city. Meralin and Kinara were suppose to go to the market together to visit them, but Kinara is late again probably still asleep as usual. Meralin decides to go and wake up Kinara and finds her lying naked on the bed. This might be the moment she has always dreamed of.
